metadata.analyzed_by: AWS Transform Custom — Agentic Readiness Analysis
metadata.repository_type_justification: Application source code (CFML) present with deployable web entry points (index.cfm, download.cfm served by ColdFusion/IIS). Single-service web application with persistent database backend.
metadata.archetype_justification: SQL Server database with CRUD document lifecycle (upload, search, download). User-specific data (userid, fullname). Entity management with uploaded_by/uploaded_on fields.

tech_stack.architecture: Monolithic web application on IIS 7 / Windows Server 2008

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes only an HTML web interface (index.cfm, download.cfm) served by Adobe ColdFusion 8 on IIS 7. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI endpoints exist. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No API exists. Only HTML pages served by IIS/ColdFusion. Integration requires brittle RPA or direct database coupling.
findings.recommendation: Design and implement a REST API layer exposing document search and download as JSON endpoints with OpenAPI documentation.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or any machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: No specification for automated agent tool generation. Manual tool authoring required.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI 3.0 specification as part of new API layer development.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error handling exists. Errors produce raw ColdFusion exception pages. No error codes, no machine-readable error bodies.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors. No structured error format.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error_code, message, and retryable fields.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection, no unique constraints on business keys for write operations.
findings.gap: Write operations will create duplicates on agent retry. No at-most-once semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints with unique constraint enforcement.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system supports file uploads (per README) with no idempotency keys. Agents retrying on failure will create duplicate documents.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add idempotency key support to write operations
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write operations accept idempotency keys and enforce at-most-once semantics

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: All responses are HTML (text/html). File downloads are application/octet-stream. No structured JSON or XML API responses.
findings.gap: Responses not agent-consumable without HTML parsing.
findings.recommendation: Design new API layer to return JSON responses exclusively.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS/EventBridge integration, or message queues.
findings.gap: Event-driven agent patterns not supported. Polling required.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge integration for document lifecycle events when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) in responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on rate limit information.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and return standard rate limit headers in API responses.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based authentication only (cfapplication sessionmanagement with session.userid check). No OAuth2 client credentials, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials. No machine identity support.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication with principal attribution
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow with per-agent identity and audit attribution

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary authorization model: logged-in or not. All authenticated users have identical access to all documents. No IAM policies, no role differentiation.
findings.gap: Cannot scope agent access to specific resources or operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with per-resource permissions.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with IAM-based resource policies
Implement reverse proxy with path-based access control

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. No permission checks distinguishing read from write, download from upload.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agent to read-only access within same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level permission checks (canRead, canWrite, canDelete) in middleware.

compensating_controls: API Gateway method-level authorization (GET vs POST/PUT/DELETE)
Network-level separation of read and write paths

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. Privilege escalation risk.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 token exchange or JWT-based identity propagation.

compensating_controls: Token exchange layer at API gateway
Custom headers with signed assertions

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials — No Secrets Management
findings.description: Database password 'cfadmin' configured in ColdFusion Administrator GUI. No secrets management, no rotation, no encryption at rest for credentials.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credential vulnerable to prompt injection leakage. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

compensating_controls: Migrate credentials to Secrets Manager immediately
Rotate database password

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no CloudWatch, no application-level logging of write operations or authenticated principals.
findings.gap: Zero audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics for any operation.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail. Implement application-level structured audit logging with caller identity for all operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution. No logging of any kind exists — cannot attribute any operation to any principal.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Enable CloudTrail for AWS account and add application audit logging
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit logs (S3 with Object Lock) capturing every write with principal, timestamp, and action

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual identities. No API key management, no user disable capability.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate misbehaving agent without full application shutdown.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API key management with immediate revocation capability.

compensating_controls: Network-level IP blocking via security groups
API key revocation at API Gateway layer

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanisms. No saga patterns, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions, no error handling.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave system in partial, unrecoverable state.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional boundaries around write operations. Add soft-delete and undo capability.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation/rollback exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows have no mechanism to recover from partial failures. File uploads go directly to disk with no reversibility.

blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern or explicit undo endpoints for all multi-step write workflows

findings.title: State Only Queryable via HTML
findings.description: Document state queryable only via HTML interface (index.cfm?q=). Results rendered as HTML tables, not machine-readable.
findings.gap: Agents cannot programmatically inspect state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Expose document state as JSON GET endpoints with filtering and pagination.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conflict resolution in any write path.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes risk data corruption through race conditions.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields to document tables and implement optimistic locking.

compensating_controls: Add version columns with optimistic locking checks
Serialize write access through a queue

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level throttling. Single IIS instance with no traffic controls.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops could DDoS the application and SQL Server at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway or AWS WAF with per-caller rate limiting.

compensating_controls: Deploy AWS WAF with rate-based rules
Configure IIS dynamic IP restrictions

findings.title: No Blast Radius Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits, no per-caller business caps, no bulk operation size limits. Queries have no bounds.
findings.gap: Agent error blast radius is unbounded — no cap on records affected.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits.

compensating_controls: Add TOP/LIMIT clauses to queries
Per-session operation counters

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft/pending state. All write operations immediately committed. No two-step confirmation.
findings.gap: Agents cannot propose changes for human review before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add DRAFT/PENDING/PUBLISHED status field. Agent uploads default to PENDING requiring approval.

compensating_controls: Add pending status column to documents table
Separate staging area for agent-proposed uploads

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. No configurable operation-level flags requiring human confirmation.
findings.gap: High-risk operations cannot be gated behind human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates per operation type.

compensating_controls: Approval queue for agent-initiated writes
Configuration flag per operation type

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging or sandbox environment. Single production instance. No docker-compose or seed data.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing. First bug will be in production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: Stage A: System stores user-specific data (userid, fullname, uploaded_by, corporate documents). Stage B — B1: All fields returned without filtering. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses expose all data indiscriminately. No field-level scoping or access differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering on API responses. Separate response DTOs for different access levels.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields returned in general API responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because agent-facing responses return all columns (doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on) without filtering. download.cfm serves any file by ID without access control.

b1.reasoning: All fields returned without filtering in index.cfm SELECT. download.cfm serves any file by ID.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single logged-in permission grants all access.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement field-level filtering. Restrict download.cfm to authorized documents only.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Agent-facing APIs return only scoped fields. Sensitive documents require elevated authorization.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Corporate documents and user data stored on local disk (D:\docroot\files) and SQL Server on single EC2. No residency configuration, no compliance framework, no region constraints.
findings.gap: No controls preventing cross-border data transmission to LLM endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Classify data sensitivity. Enforce residency via VPC endpoints and service control policies.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no data residency controls for system with persistent user data.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores corporate policy documents and employee data with zero geographic or jurisdictional controls. An agent could transmit document content to any LLM endpoint without boundary enforcement.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Classify data sensitivity and determine applicable residency requirements
blocker_remediation.target_state: Data residency enforced via VPC endpoints and SCPs. LLM calls restricted to same-region endpoints.

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Size Limits
findings.description: Search query returns all matching documents without pagination. No LIMIT, OFFSET, or cursor. Results unbounded.
findings.gap: Agent queries could return unbounded result sets exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination (limit/offset or cursor) and enforce maximum result size.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
findings.description: Zero input validation. Critical SQL injection: url.q concatenated into SQL (WHERE title LIKE '%#url.q#%'), url.id concatenated directly (WHERE doc_id = #url.id#). No parameterized queries.
findings.gap: System accepts arbitrary input including SQL injection payloads. No validation error responses.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with cfqueryparam parameterized queries immediately. Add input validation.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata — No Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Basic timestamp (uploaded_on) exists but no timezone normalization, no freshness signaling, no cache headers.
findings.gap: Timezone handling undefined. No mechanism to signal data freshness to agents.
findings.recommendation: Store timestamps in UTC. Add updated_at fields. Implement Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction mechanism. User data (fullname, userid) handled without log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: User PII could leak into ColdFusion logs without redaction.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with PII field exclusion and log scrubbing.

compensating_controls: Configure ColdFusion logging to exclude request bodies
Implement log masking at infrastructure level

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality monitoring, completeness metrics, or duplicate detection.
findings.gap: Agents may act on incomplete or duplicate data without awareness.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality metrics for the documents table.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no database migration files, no API contracts, no changelog.
findings.gap: Schema changes would silently break agent integrations. No breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement database migration versioning and API contract detection in CI pipeline.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. Database schema only inferable from SELECT statements in source code.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires reverse-engineering schema from code.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary documenting all tables and fields.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs, no OpenTelemetry. ColdFusion 8 predates modern observability.
findings.gap: Zero debuggability for agent-initiated requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring, no error rate tracking.
findings.gap: Cannot detect system degradation before agent cascading failures.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency with anomaly detection.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manually provisioned Windows Server 2008 EC2 instance. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No peer review, no drift detection, no code-managed infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as code using Terraform or CDK.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment is manual file copy over network share. No automated testing or contract validation.
findings.gap: API contract changes not caught before agents affected. No deployment safety net.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual file copy deployment with no versioning or automation.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments. Manual file restoration only option.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files exist. No unit tests, integration tests, API tests, or contract tests.
findings.gap: No automated verification of behavior. Changes cannot be validated.
findings.recommendation: Create automated test suite covering all API endpoints with contract tests in CI.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Local disk storage (D:\docroot\files) unencrypted. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE.
findings.gap: All data at rest unencrypted. Disk theft exposes all documents.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with SSE-KMS and upgrade to RDS with encryption.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no long-running operations (>30s) or long-running workflows detected in this service.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service has no external dependencies (does not call other services or external APIs).

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and not identified as critical path service.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful and human-readable: doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on, filename. No legacy codes requiring a data dictionary.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on building an API layer, implementing machine identity, audit logging, and foundational security controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, IaC, CI/CD, and operational maturity.
Polish agent integration quality: API documentation, event emission, data quality monitoring, and test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer with JSON responses and OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: No API exists — this is the fundamental blocker. All other improvements depend on having a programmable interface.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity, no scoped permissions, no action-level auth. Cannot authenticate or authorize agents without a complete identity overhaul.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution
recommended_actions.rationale: Zero audit trail currently. Required for compliance and forensics of agent operations.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded password ('cfadmin') documented in README. Immediate security risk independent of agent readiness.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data classification and residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Corporate documents stored without classification or residency controls. Agent could transmit sensitive data to any LLM endpoint.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy rate limiting and implement transaction bounds
recommended_actions.rationale: No traffic or business operation limits. Runaway agent could overwhelm single-instance application.

recommended_actions.action: Fix SQL injection vulnerabilities with parameterized queries
recommended_actions.rationale: Critical security vulnerability. Agents sending natural language queries could inadvertently trigger SQL injection.

recommended_actions.action: Define infrastructure as code and implement CI/CD pipeline
recommended_actions.rationale: Manual infrastructure and deployment. Cannot safely iterate on agent-facing surface without deployment automation.
